descripcion: Caricatura 2D vintage estilo Tom y Jerry 90s, fondo azul pálido sólido, personajes fijos Tom (gato) y Jerry (ratón). Para finanzas/historias con tono juguetón.
character_ficha: CHARACTER: Tom, a gray and white anthropomorphic cat with short gray fur (#8A9BA8), white muzzle, white belly and white paws, large yellow-green eyes, pink nose, pink inner ears, thin gray tail with white tip, ALWAYS wearing an olive green turtleneck sweater (#6B8E5A) and khaki beige pants (#C2B280), no shoes, no hat, no glasses, no extra clothes; and Jerry, a small brown mouse (#8B5A2B) with large round pink ears, ALWAYS wearing a black tuxedo with white shirt and black bow tie, no shoes, no hat. Both in vintage Tom and Jerry cartoon style with clean bold black outlines.
style_ficha: STYLE: vintage Tom and Jerry 2D cartoon illustration, flat colors, clean bold black outlines, minimal shading, no gradients, no photorealism, no 3D, solid pale light blue background (#BFE0EC), simple iconic props, soft even lighting, vertical 9:16 composition.
trazo: clean bold black outlines, grosor uniforme, sin sketch
anti_drift: DEPRECATED (v1, solo compat): Keep the SAME two characters identical in EVERY scene. Usar anti_drift_estilo + anti_drift_personaje.
anti_drift_estilo: Keep the same art style and background in every image: vintage Tom and Jerry 2D cartoon illustration, flat colors, clean bold black outlines, minimal shading, no gradients, no photorealism, no 3D. Keep solid pale light blue background (#BFE0EC) in every scene.
anti_drift_personaje: When Tom and Jerry appear, keep them identical: Tom with olive green turtleneck (#6B8E5A) and khaki pants (#C2B280), Jerry with black tuxedo. Do NOT change their clothes, colors, fur, eyes or proportions. Do NOT add shoes, hats, glasses or new outfits. Secondary humans (e.g. bank teller) as simple cartoon humans with white shirt and tie, never as protagonists.
frase_referencia_con: Using the attached reference image(s) as the style and character reference, generate a new image in the same art style with the same protagonists.
frase_referencia_sin: Using the attached reference image(s) as the style and background reference only. Do not add any mascot or character unless named in the prompt.
personajes_secundarios: Solo Tom y Jerry como protagonistas. Humanos secundarios (cajero, gerente) siempre simples: piel clara, camisa blanca, corbata, sin protagonismo, nunca con ropa de Tom/Jerry.
